windowingDecision.rule: Draw the lines whose y range meets the rows scroll view plus an overscan of one view height, at least 120 px (lineWindow, MIN_OVERSCAN_PX in layout.ts). stripLayout keeps every line.
windowingDecision.mechanism: useRowWindow.ts: an external store of { topPx, heightPx } bound to .runtl-scroll by a passive scroll listener (one update per animation frame) and a ResizeObserver; Gutter, Grounds and Rows read it through useSyncExternalStore.

windowingProfile.note: CPU profile (CDP sampling, 200 us) of 10 s at 30x, strip open and expanded, at 41476e2; inclusive ms. Before windowing LaneItems was about 455 ms, Grounds about 93 ms and Gutter rows about 60 ms. The strip entries are now small; the canvas and the analysis panel dominate, and the remaining long frames sit on top of them.

inkSearch.rule: Lightest value in each paper ink's own HSL hue and saturation (0.05 percent lightness steps) that clears 3.01 on the paper panel #f7f5f0, on the selected ground (text 1 at 6 percent over the panel), at 0.75 opacity over the panel and on each other ground the ink draws on (sensor on the group ground, EW on the overview ground, quiet on the unobserved ground), and for EW and DE a duration at 4.51 on the fill.
inkSearch.text1OnFill: Infeasible for EW and DE: the 0.75 floor needs a fill luminance of at most 0.150 (EW) and 0.149 (DE); text 1 at 4.5:1 needs at least 0.247. The duration stays in the paper board ink (--accent-ink).
